note: Values tied to a specific hardware model. Fixed-board constants may be HARDWARE_CONSTANT (allowed inline in that board's own module). Values that vary BY DEVICE MODEL must live here, keyed by model, and never inline in shared logic.

device_profiles.source: manufacturer datasheet (placeholder — no real device wired into DNA OS yet as of 2026-08-04)
forbidden_locations: engines/*, core business logic, any module shared across device models
device_profiles.rationale: Pin numbers are fixed by the physical board revision named in the id; a different board revision needs its own profile entry, not an edit to this one.
device_profiles.validation_rule: pin map object keyed by logical signal name, only referenced through drivers/hardware/<model>/pinmap.ts
device_profiles.status: placeholder — DNA OS has no live hardware driver as of this entry; created as the schema example, not an active device

rule: If a value changes across device models/revisions, it is NOT a plain HARDWARE_CONSTANT — it MUST be added as its own device_profiles entry here (or a hardware registry row keyed by model), never hardcoded into shared/central logic.
